_docs: Image banner ads, sold via /advertise/ (Tally form). 'sidebar' = one site-wide banner in the right column of the homepage, category pages, Start here, About, the blog and guides (600x500 image, shown at 300x250). 'category' = one banner per category, placed between the listings (1200x300 image, shown up to 600 wide). Fields: name (advertiser, used for alt text fallback and analytics), image (path under static/, e.g. /banners/clayground-600x500.png), alt (what the banner says), url, category (category slugs only). Empty slots render nothing. Every banner is labelled 'Ad' and links with rel=sponsored.
